sources_lede: Where each phrase comes from and the licence it is used under. An unreviewed draft has not yet been checked against a source.
how_to_lede: Topics are tiles. Tap a tile to go in, and use Back to return.
how_to_tree: The home page shows groups of topics as tiles. A group opens its topics as tiles, and a topic opens its words and phrases. The bar at the top shows where you are, and the narrow bar at the side has Back and Settings.
how_to_touch_back: Press the Back arrow in the narrow bar at the side, or drag the page to the right and let go.
how_to_keys_along: Down arrow and Up arrow. Home and End jump to the first and last.
how_to_keys_open: Tab to a tile, then Enter. The Right arrow also opens the focused tile.
how_to_note_edge: A drag that starts at the very edge of the screen is left to your device, so its own back gesture still works. Let go early and the page springs back.
how_to_note_reader: Each tile is a link named in both languages, so a screen reader reads both.
how_to_note_offline: Once the app is installed the whole tree works without a network.
licence_draft: Unreviewed draft: source and licence to be confirmed
settings_lede: Choose how the site looks. Your choices stay on this device and are never sent anywhere.
settings_no_script: Settings need scripts to be switched on in your browser. Without them the site follows your device's light or dark setting and uses the default colours.
how_to_keys_settings: Tab to the gear in the narrow bar at the side, then Enter.
how_to_touch_settings: Tap the gear in the narrow bar at the side.
search_hint: Type a word or phrase in {first} or {second}.
search_error: The word list could not be loaded.
